name: Bibliothèque électronique du Québec
legal: Textes du domaine public (droit canadien) diffusés gratuitement par la Bibliothèque électronique du Québec, sans DRM. Bibliothèque complète pour l'instant ; le filtre « domaine public en France » existe et peut être activé (france_public_domain).
notes: No OPDS or catalogue file: the static collection pages are parsed (owner's yes, 2026-10-31, replacing Wikisource). robots.txt allows everything we read and asks Crawl-delay: 10, which PoliteHttpClient honours. BEQ follows Canadian law (life+50). Owner's decision 2026-10-31: full library for now, the French public-domain filter (france_public_domain: true) is kept but OFF, to be discussed later. A heading is only used as author when the file name matches it. Pages not yet parsed: libertinage, Philosophie, Propagande, contemporain (living authors, by permission: needs a separate legal look), author pages such as vents/zola.htm (layout not recorded yet).
